paper_title: AI hybrid survival assessment for advanced heart failure patients with renal dysfunction
prediction_task: Survival prediction in advanced heart failure with renal dysfunction (6-30 month horizons)

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Cohort is predominantly HFpEF with <20% HFrEF — surprising. AHF may differ in prognosis and treatment between HFpEF and HFrEF. Would it be better to focus on a specific type?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added subtype-specific analysis and discussed clinical implications of the HFpEF-dominant cohort.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: It would be beneficial to provide the TRIPOD statement and checklist. Why use all-cause mortality not specific cause? What particular length of survival is the target?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added TRIPOD checklist. Clarified outcome as all-cause mortality at 6/12/24/30 months.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Need more details on imputation. Is MAR mechanism justified? How much data was missing and for which parameters? Biomarkers may be 'missing' depending on patient's state — healthier patients have fewer examinations.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added missing data analysis with MNAR sensitivity analysis.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Average age in external cohort much higher than training cohort. All-cause mortality also much higher. Why should this not impact generalizability?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Discussed age and mortality differences and showed model calibration remained adequate after recalibration.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: The paper lacks detailed comparisons across the 12 ML methods used. How do individual models compare? What is the rationale for the specific ensemble strategy?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added individual model performance comparison table and ensemble ablation analysis.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Could authors clarify about the database — are these all hospitalization records or both inpatient and outpatient? Missing values — how much data was missing?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified data source and added comprehensive missing data summary.

reviewer_strengths.text: Multiple AI/ML approaches integrated into workflow. Model tested in external validation cohort and compared to other predictive algorithms, found comparable or better.
